title: The Colleague Who Never Gossiped
paragraphs: In an office where gossip about coworkers was common during lunch breaks, one colleague, Maryam, consistently steered conversations away whenever people started criticizing someone who was not present to defend themselves.
At first, some colleagues found this mildly annoying, feeling that Maryam was being unnecessarily strict about harmless conversation that everyone else seemed to enjoy without any real consequence.
Over time, however, several people began confiding in Maryam specifically because they trusted she would never repeat what was shared or speak negatively about them once they left the room.

Years later, when Maryam was promoted to a leadership position, many colleagues privately admitted that her consistent refusal to participate in gossip was exactly what had earned their genuine trust.
